name: OVHcloud
description: OVHcloud infrastructure: Public Cloud instances, VPS and dedicated/eco bare metal; order catalogs, carts, delivery, Linux installation, lifecycle, upgrades, volumes, snapshots and S3 object storage. VPS and dedicated cancellation can require email-token confirmation. Domains: register domains (including .pl) directly or through carts, manage name servers, glue/DS records, contacts, renewals, transfer codes, and DNS zones (records, refresh, DNSSEC, redirections).

tools.name: domain_order_create
tools.description: Register (order) a new domain name directly, without a cart. This is a paid purchase. Always call it first with dryRun=true to get availability and the exact price, show that price to the user, then place the real order with dryRun=false, waiveRetractationPeriod=true and priceAcknowledge set to the quoted price (required for premium/aftermarket domains; a mismatch rejects the order). Payment follows the account's preferred payment method. Track progress with domain_task_list. (OVH API status: beta)

admin.description: Administrative contact, given as an OVH NIC handle (e.g. xxxxx-ovh). Defaults to the calling customer's NIC if omitted.

id.description: Numeric identifier of the OVH contact resource (e.g. obtained from /me/contact). Distinct from a NIC handle such as xxxxx-ovh.

owner.description: Owner contact of the domain. Unlike admin/tech which are NIC handles, the owner is an OVH contact resource referenced by its numeric id.

tech.description: Technical contact, given as an OVH NIC handle (e.g. xxxxx-ovh). Defaults to the admin contact if omitted.

dns.description: List of DNS servers (hostnames) to set on the domain. Optional: if omitted, OVHcloud's recommended DNS servers for the domain are used.

domain.description: Fully-qualified domain name to order, including the extension (e.g. example.com)

duration.description: Order duration in ISO-8601 format, whole years only (e.g. P1Y). Allowed values depend on the extension's registry configuration; an unsupported duration is rejected. Defaults to P1Y if omitted.

currencyCode.description: Currency code of the acknowledged price

value.description: The effective price acknowledged by the client

priceAcknowledge.description: Price the customer acknowledged before placing the order. Required for aftermarket or premium domains, optional otherwise. Its value/currency must equal the retail price quoted for this domain (e.g. via a dryRun order); a mismatch rejects the order.

waiveRetractationPeriod.description: Acknowledgment that the customer waives the legal retractation period. Must be set to true to place the order.

anycast.description: Enable Anycast on the DNS zone. Applied only when a new zone is created (create=true and no existing zone); ignored otherwise.

create.description: Whether to create the DNS zone along with the domain. Defaults to true if omitted.

dnssec.description: Enable DNSSEC on the DNS zone. Applied only when a new zone is created (create=true and no existing zone); defaults to true in that case when omitted.

dryRun.description: If true, simulate the order and return the pricing without actually placing it. Default to false.
